critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3237-3259 _send_email_with_attachments: silent-fail if RESEND_API_KEY missing or exception — correct for testing (endpoints still 200) but logs error via logger.error. OK.
server.py L3266-3273 _photo_attachment: correctly strips 'data:...,' prefix before b64decode — robust.
server.py L3282-3293 register_payment: enforces amount>0 and amount<=balance+0.01 (nice epsilon). Balance recompute uses final_value OR negotiated_value fallback (L3232) — good.

server.py L3321-3327 complete-balance path: sets ready_for_delivery + transitions status from SERVICIO_COMPLETADO/TERMINADO_FALTA_PAGO to TERMINADO_PAGADO. Note: if order was in ASIGNADO/EN_PROCESO it does NOT auto-terminate (only ready_for_delivery flips) — likely intended (payment before service completion).

server.py L3487-3519 authorize_release: 400 with clear msg 'No se puede autorizar salida: falta pago de $N'. Sets release_authorized_by_name for UI. Idempotent-ish (re-calling on already-authorized order simply overwrites timestamp — consider guarding).

server.py L3654-3716 seed_test_orders: strictly idempotent (find by plate+cedula) — good. But sets service_completed_at only for SERVICIO_COMPLETADO/TERMINADO_PAGADO — GHI456 (INGRESADO) intentionally has no service_completed_at.
server.py L3564 invoice_number formula uses order_code which can be empty on legacy orders — falls back to '' but works. Consider requiring order_code.

server.py L3453-3462 orders_pending_release query uses {'delivered_at': {'$in': [None]}} — works but 'field missing OR null' matches both. Cleaner: {'$or': [{'delivered_at': None}, {'delivered_at': {'$exists': false}}]}. Currently OK because $in [None] matches missing fields in Mongo? Actually $in [null] DOES match missing fields — Mongo semantic — so it's fine.
Pagos.jsx L69 setAmount(String(o.balance||'')) — if balance=0 pre-fills empty; but pay-btn is already disabled for balance<=0. Fine.

FacturacionElectronica.jsx: emailOverride entered in UI is NEVER sent to backend — only used to gate the send button. Backend uses order.client_email. Either wire the override through the endpoint payload or add a note that the email must be edited on the order first.
AutosSalida.jsx uses 30s polling interval — reasonable but consider debouncing on tab-visibility-change to reduce load.
